## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The `--exclude` default should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can omit matching files through environment configuration.

## Changes

The pull request adds and documents a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file basenames, logs skipped files at INFO level, and adds parser and archive tests.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` argument, the empty-list default lets `debug.log` into the archive. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment will archive files they intended to skip.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Test exact basename matching in a subdirectory — No test verifies that `--exclude skip.log` omits `src/nested/skip.log`. The existing matching tests use wildcard suffixes that also match full paths. — A regression that matches full paths could pass these tests while including files explicitly excluded by basename.
